text: Toyo Tire Corporation is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Prime Market (code 5105). Its largest shareholders (as of 2026-06-30) were Mitsubishi Corporation (20.01%), The Master Trust Bank of Japan (trust account, 12.56%) and Custody Bank of Japan (trust account, 6.83%); no state or sovereign shareholder appears in the company's top-10 list. Toyo Tire states Mitsubishi Corporation ceased to qualify as a major shareholder on 2026-08-10.
short: Toyo Tire is TSE-Prime listed (5105); Mitsubishi Corp and trust banks are the top holders, no state shareholder.
